description: Aguero scores a dramatic injury-time goal to win the Premier League title for Manchester City in the most breathtaking finale in league history.
significance: Aguero93: Premier League title won in stoppage time

description: Michael Thomas scores in the last minute of the last game of the season to hand Arsenal the league title on goal difference at Anfield.
significance: Arsenal win title at Anfield in the final seconds

description: Teddy Sheringham equalises in injury time for Manchester United, pulling them level in the Champions League Final.
significance: Start of the greatest comeback in European football

description: Ole Gunnar Solskjaer taps in to complete the most dramatic comeback in Champions League Final history, winning the treble for United.
significance: Solskjaer wins the Champions League in the last minute

description: Arsenal secure the Premier League title at Highbury without losing a single game all season, completing the Invincibles campaign.
significance: Arsenal confirmed Invincibles — unbeaten entire 38-game season

description: Steven Gerrard heads home to begin Liverpool's incredible comeback from 3-0 down at half time in the Champions League Final in Istanbul.
significance: Istanbul Miracle begins — Gerrard header starts 3-goal comeback

description: Fernando Torres rounds the goalkeeper and finishes coolly as Chelsea produce a stunning counter-attack at the Nou Camp in the Champions League semifinal.
significance: Torres goal caps stunning Chelsea counter-attack at Nou Camp

description: Son Heung-min scores a stunning solo goal to put Tottenham ahead at the Etihad in a pulsating Champions League quarter-final.
significance: Son's solo run and finish in dramatic CL quarter-final

description: Manchester City concede an injury-time equaliser to Real Madrid at the Etihad, capping a breathless Champions League semifinal second leg.
significance: Real Madrid's famous injury-time equaliser at Etihad

description: Jamie Vardy scores his 11th consecutive Premier League game, breaking Ruud van Nistelrooy's record with a thunderous finish.
significance: Vardy breaks consecutive scoring record — 11 games in a row

description: Patrick Vieira is sent off in a feisty North London Derby as Arsenal's 49-game unbeaten run finally comes to an end.
significance: Red card ends Arsenal's unbeaten run in the North London Derby

description: Arsenal go in at half time 4-1 down at the Etihad, effectively ending their Premier League title challenge in a crushing first-half capitulation.
significance: Arsenal title hopes crushed after 4-1 half-time deficit at Etihad

description: Bukayo Saka cuts inside and curls a magnificent effort into the top corner, capping a brilliant individual performance.
significance: Saka curls one into the top corner with trademark left foot

description: Ilkay Gundogan scores twice in five minutes as Manchester City come from 2-0 down to win 3-2 and clinch the Premier League title.
significance: Gundogan brace seals stunning last-day title comeback for City

description: Erling Haaland scores his 25th Premier League goal of the season — the fastest any player has reached 25 goals in a single top-flight campaign.
significance: Haaland reaches 25 PL goals faster than any player in history

description: Bukayo Saka wins a penalty after a clumsy challenge. Arsenal's high press forces the error from deep inside City's defensive third.
significance: Arsenal's high press wins penalty — tactical masterclass from Arteta

description: Kevin De Bruyne fires a long-range thunderbolt to equalise for City against Liverpool in the Champions League quarter-final second leg.
significance: De Bruyne's 94th minute thunderbolt stuns Liverpool

description: Kevin De Bruyne delivers a whipped cross from the right and Erling Haaland rises above Gabriel to head home the winner for City.
significance: De Bruyne-Haaland combination delivers late winner at Emirates

description: Arsenal score in the dying minutes from a set-piece routine they had clearly worked on in training, catching Tottenham completely off guard.
significance: Practised set-piece wins north London derby in dying minutes

description: Phil Foden receives the ball in a tight pocket between Arsenal's midfield lines, turns brilliantly and plays a through-ball splitting the defence.
significance: Foden's genius through-ball splits Arsenal's defensive block
